alignment: center-aligned (text-anchor: middle, x=300, block centered on viewBox 480)
purpose: Horizontal lockup, center-aligned — chevron mark + 智御无疆 + Kaup wordmark form a single centered block. Designed for hero sections, marketing headers, email signatures, and card/banner contexts where the lockup is the focal element rather than a navigation anchor.

sizes.1024w: large marketing headers, hero banners (1024×341 px)
sizes.256w: inline hero lockup, mobile splash (256×85 px)

min_physical_size: 30mm width at 300dpi — below this the chevron stroke starts to feather
use_when: the lockup is the focal element on a centered composition (hero, splash, signature, card) — NOT for app headers or nav bars
